description: Template definitions for prospective Class C entries in MURU_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.json.

entries.statement: Structural-null calibration validity verdict, valid world count of 100, and 20-complexity monotonic threshold table T(c).
Per-construction calibration 95th percentile breakdown (target-permuted 34, descriptors-permuted 33, gaussian 33) and constant-model R2 diagnostics.
Development 80-case sanity execution record across all 11 endpoints under Amendment A3.1/A3.2 contract.
Primary Gate G1 Scalar Competence: numerator against 164 held-out cases, point rate, and Wilson 95% interval against lower bound >= 0.70.
Primary Gate G2 Family Recovery: numerator against 144 held-out cases, point rate, and Wilson 95% interval against lower bound >= 0.70.
Primary Gate G3 Principal Structural Safety: violation count against 36 held-out opportunities (with UNEVALUABLE as violation), point rate, and Wilson 95% interval against upper bound <= 0.15.
Umbrella Benchmark Scientific Claim verdict: positive iff calibration valid and all three primary gates (G1, G2, G3) pass.
Joint Parameter Recovery secondary endpoint: numerator against 156 held-out cases, rate, and Wilson 95% interval.
Mass Exponent Recovery secondary component: numerator against 156 held-out cases within |p - p_truth| <= 0.15, rate, and Wilson 95% interval.
Descriptor Coupling Recovery secondary component: numerator against 84 descriptor-dependent held-out cases within |c - c_truth| <= 0.10, rate, and Wilson 95% interval.
Predictive Equivalence secondary endpoint: numerator against 144 held-out cases over 2,160 reference points across 12 frames, rate, and Wilson 95% interval.
Exact Algebra Recovery secondary endpoint: symbolic equivalence numerator against 60 held-out cases, rate, Wilson 95% interval, and distinct functional class counts.
Support Recovery secondary endpoint: effective support MATCH numerator against 144 held-out cases, rate, and Wilson 95% interval.
Model Adequacy outcomes: M0 specificity (164), M1 sensitivity (36), M2 sensitivity (24), M3 sensitivity (24), and F16 combined breakdown.
False Discovery and Refusal breakdown: F07 (12), F19 (12 with A/B/C variants), F20 (12 with A/B/C variants), and F06 legitimate refusals (12).
Diagnostic endpoints: F05 boundary-hit rate (12), F19C response-structure diagnostic (4), and scalar target yield (164).
Noise Envelope comparison: prospective recovery rates across F01 (noiseless), F02 (moderate), and F03 (stronger).
Census of typed failure states across held-out execution (REJECTED_A1_INADEQUATE, UNEVALUABLE, SUPPORT_UNRESOLVED, FAMILY_AMBIGUOUS, COMPLETED_NO_CANDIDATE, EXECUTION_FAILURE).
